race.comment: SARAPO (4) has the right profile after closing off soundly in a BM70 at Cranbourne despite being tightened early, racing keenly and then held up at key stages. He now eases from metro company, brings Damian Lane for Chris Waller and was beaten just under a length at Geelong the run prior, so he looks the one to beat. LADY THINKABELL (6) is the main danger second-up after keeping on at Ballarat on heavy ground, with last preparation's Listed Centaurea Stakes run giving her a stronger background than most of these. GARNACHO (1) went within just under a length at Pakenham after being held up and steadied, and his wet-track record keeps him in the mix despite the top weight. WOLFESS (8) is suited coming back from BM66 grade after a Sale fifth where home-turn interference made the margin look a touch harsher than the run. Can figure.
